bundles.displayName: 高新技术企业申报体检
bundles.descriptionZh: 免费版高企申报资格与材料体检：依据国科发火〔2016〕32号与195号逐项核验八大硬门槛、双年度成长性与四列缺口清单，严认原件不估分。
bundles.descriptionEn: Free High-Tech Enterprise eligibility and material checkup against national guidelines with deterministic growth checks and four-column remediation gaps.
examplesZh: 我们今年能报高企吗，帮我按原件核对一下八大硬门槛还缺什么。
今年报还是明年报更稳？财务报表和专利清单都发你了，做个双年度高企体检。
帮我核一下我们近三年研发费用占比和成长性，列一份四列补强清单。
examplesEn: Check whether our company meets the eight hard criteria for High-Tech Enterprise recognition.
Compare this year vs next year eligibility windows using our financial statements and IP list.
Recalculate our three-year R&D ratio and growth rates and list four-column remediation gaps.

bundles.descriptionZh: 免费版专精特新与小巨人申报体检：依据工信部企业〔2026〕2号核验硬门槛、研发强度、主营占比、资产负债率与申请书基础矛盾，输出四列补强清单，严认原件不估分。
bundles.descriptionEn: Free Specialized SME and Little Giant eligibility checkup under MIIT 2026 rules with deterministic financial checks and four-column remediation gaps.
examplesZh: 我们想报浙江专精特新，把近两年财报和专利清单发你了，先做个免费体检看看能不能报。
准备冲国家级小巨人，目前只有两件发明专利，帮我逐项查一下还差哪些硬门槛。
帮我核一下主营占比、研发强度和资产负债率，列一份带优先级的四列补强清单。
examplesEn: Run a Specialized SME eligibility checkup using our latest financial statements and IP list.
Check our Little Giant hard-gate gaps when we currently hold two granted invention patents.
Verify our core revenue ratio, R&D intensity, and debt ratio with a prioritized gap table.

bundles.displayName: 高新技术企业申请书撰写
bundles.descriptionZh: 收费版高企申请书撰写与原 Word 母版无损回填引擎：含 v1.2 行业设计控制目标写法、整栏 400 字网报口径、RD/PS 自动扩缩表与逐格保真审计。
bundles.descriptionEn: Paid High-Tech Enterprise application drafting and lossless DOCX master template filling engine with v1.2 engineering targets and fidelity auditing.
examplesZh: 按这六个研发项目和两个产品清单，帮我撰写 RD/PS 正文并无损回填进高企申请书 Word 母版。
帮我写高企申请书的 PS01 关键技术及主要技术指标，缺实测参数的地方结合行业成熟工艺写设计控制目标。
高企申请书已经填好，帮我按网报 400 字口径和黑板估算清单跑一遍保真审计。
examplesEn: Draft RD/PS narratives and fill them losslessly into the High-Tech Enterprise DOCX master template.
Write PS01 key technologies and engineering design control targets where test reports are pending.
Audit the filled High-Tech DOCX against the 400-character portal limit and blackboard estimates.

bundles.displayName: 专精特新撰写与培育方案
bundles.descriptionZh: 收费版专精特新与小巨人撰写与培育引擎：含主导产品双字段升维与业态三分支、专利三级分流、六问六答、八段企业简介正文撰写与方向卡成品交付。
bundles.descriptionEn: Paid Specialized SME & Little Giant drafting and cultivation engine with dual-field product anchoring, 3-tier patent triage, Q1-Q6 strategy, and full narrative drafting.
examplesZh: 我们主营冷冻蛋挞皮，帮我做主导产品升维定名、专利三级分流，并输出专精特新六问六答和企业简介正文。
结合我们的塑料包装瓶专利和设备专利，帮我定准主导产品避免跑偏，并生成主导产品技术情况介绍。
帮我把已有的专精特新申请书按四项判断和 v1.2 口径做深度修订，输出修改正文与 Q2 发明专利补强清单。
examplesEn: Anchor and upgrade our leading product name, triage patents into 3 tiers, and draft the SME enterprise introduction.
Separate manufacturing equipment patents from our core product and draft the core technology narrative.
Revise our Specialized SME application under the four-judgment rubric and output Q2 patent mining topics.
